patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've had this smooth, round lump on the back of my wrist for a few weeks. It doesn't really hurt, it's soft and squishy, and it seems to change size. I just want to know it's nothing bad.
clinical.presentationShort: 31yo F — soft, mobile, transilluminating dorsal wrist mass, painless, no functional limit — ganglion cyst.
clinical.presentationLong: 31-year-old female with a soft, mobile, transilluminating dorsal wrist mass, painless and without functional limitation — a ganglion cyst.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → reassurance, observation, elective referral if bothersome; benign. No ED workup needed.
diagnosis.why: Soft, mobile, transilluminating, painless wrist bump = ganglion cyst. Reassure; it's benign. A clean discharge.
